mapper.sql: select id, employee_code, company_code, client_id, employee_name, employee_email, employee_phone, vendor_id, location, employee_active, contract_start_date, contract_end_date, remark, extra_data, created_at, modified_at from sys_employee
mapper.select: SELECT e.*, c.client_name AS client_name, v.vendor_name AS vendor_name FROM sys_employee e JOIN sys_client c ON e.client_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sys_vendor v ON e.vendor_id = v.id WHERE e.id = #{id};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_employee ( client_id, company_code, employee_code, employee_name, employee_email, employee_phone, vendor_id, location, employee_active, contract_start_date, contract_end_date, remark, extra_data ) VALUES ( #{clientId}, #{companyCode}, #{employeeCode}, #{employeeName}, #{employeeEmail}, #{employeePhone}, #{vendorId}, #{location}, #{employeeActive}, #{contractStartDate}, #{contractEndDate}, #{remark}, #{extraData, typeHandler=com.nnroad.framework.datasource.JsonTypeHandler} );
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_employee SET client_id = #{clientId}, company_code = #{companyCode}, employee_code = #{employeeCode}, employee_name = #{employeeName}, employee_email = #{employeeEmail}, employee_phone = #{employeePhone}, vendor_id = #{vendorId}, location = #{location}, employee_active = #{employeeActive}, contract_start_date = #{contractStartDate}, contract_end_date = #{contractEndDate}, remark = #{remark}, created_at = #{createdAt}, modified_at = #{modifiedAt}, extra_data = #{extraData, typeHandler=com.nnroad.framework.datasource.JsonTypeHandler} WHERE id = #{id};
